Leibniz Institute for the Analysis of Biodiversity Change, Museum Koenig, Bonn

organism_part_definitions.WHOLE_ORGANISM: the whole organism (please comment in OTHER_INFORMATION [column BZ] if, for example, wings or genettalia were removed for identification, or appendages or other sample taken for DNA barcoding)
organism_part_definitions.HEAD: the head of arthropods (and of other animals where distinct; use ANTERIOR_BODY where this is not the case)
organism_part_definitions.FAT_BODY: dissected fat body or fat body tissue
organism_part_definitions.INTESTINE: any part of the digestive intestine, specifically excluding STOMACH in vertebrates; may include accessory glandular tissue
organism_part_definitions.BODYWALL: the body wall of non-vertebrate animals (incorporating ectodermal and mesodermal components, but excluding intestine)
organism_part_definitions.TERMINAL_BODY: the very terminal body of non-vertebrate animals, likely not including intestine
organism_part_definitions.ANTERIOR_BODY: the anterior whole body of non-vertebrate animals, likely including anterior nervous system, oropharyngeal apparatus, and anterior intestine
organism_part_definitions.MID_BODY: the mid whole body of non-vertebrate animals, likely including intestine
organism_part_definitions.POSTERIOR_BODY: the posterior whole body of non-vertebrate animals, likely including intestine
organism_part_definitions.LEG: any locomotory appendage of tetrapods or arthropods
organism_part_definitions.BLOOD: the blood of animals (vertebrate blood and the haemocoel fluid of animals with open circulations)
organism_part_definitions.STOMACH: the stomach of vertebrates (use INTESTINE for non vertebrate intestinal tissue)
organism_part_definitions.MUSCLE: isolated muscle or dissected muscle tissue
organism_part_definitions.MODULAR_COLONY: a sample including multiple individual organisms (zooids) from a modular colony
organism_part_definitions.TENTACLE: a tentacle from cnidarians and some spiralian animals
organism_part_definitions.SKIN: dissected ectodermal tissue (including dermis and subdermis in vertebrates)
organism_part_definitions.EGGSHELL: the eggshell of birds or reptiles
organism_part_definitions.HAIR: the hair and follicular tissue of mammals
organism_part_definitions.GILL_ANIMAL: the respiratory gill of aquatic vertebrates, and of other animals
organism_part_definitions.**OTHER_SOMATIC_ANIMAL_TISSUE**: (use this term if the animal organ, tissue or body part you have sampled is not covered by the other somatic tissue terms above. Please describe the organism part in the OTHER_INFORMATION field [column BZ])
organism_part_definitions.GONAD: animal gonadal tissue or whole organ (also use for gonad of hermaphroditic animals where testicular and ovarian function is not clearly distinguished)
organism_part_definitions.OVARY_ANIMAL: animal ovary (female gonad) tissue or whole organ
organism_part_definitions.TESTIS: animal testis (male gonad) tissue or whole organ
organism_part_definitions.SPERM_SEMINAL_FLUID: animal sperm in seminal fluid from a male animal
organism_part_definitions.EGG: the eggs  from a single female animal (fertilised or unfertilised, as laid by or taken from the ovary or egg sac of)
organism_part_definitions.**OTHER_REPRODUCTIVE_ANIMAL_TISSUE**: (use this term if the animal reproductive organ, tissue or body part you have sampled is not covered by the other reproductive tissue terms above. Please describe the organism part in the OTHER_INFORMATION field [column BZ])
organism_part_definitions.WHOLE_PLANT: entire mature sporophyte or gametophyte, including above- and below-ground parts where appropriate
organism_part_definitions.SEEDLING: entire, or above-ground part of, juvenile plant that has been raised from seed or spores (not from cuttings or division)
organism_part_definitions.SEED: embryonic plant sporophyte, taxonomically restricted to the Spermatophyta
organism_part_definitions.LEAF: planar plant appendage, of sporophytic or gametophytic origin, that is attached to a stem; usually photosynthetic
organism_part_definitions.FLOWER: seed-bearing part of an angiosperm, comprising reproductive organs (stamens and/or carpels) typically surrounded by corolla (petals) and  calyx (sepals); will contain sporophytic and gametophytic tissue
organism_part_definitions.BLADE: for macroalgae, a flattened structure that resembles a leaf
organism_part_definitions.STEM: a primary plant axis that develops organs like buds and shoots
organism_part_definitions.PETIOLE: part of a vascular plant leaf that subtends the flattened lamina
organism_part_definitions.SHOOT: a stem including its appendages, e.g. leaves, buds, flowers
organism_part_definitions.BUD: a compact growth on a vascular plant that can develop into a leaf, flower, or shoot
organism_part_definitions.THALLUS_PLANT: in plants and 'plant-like' organisms (e.g. macroalgae), a planar vegetative body that is not differentiated into leaf, stem and root, but may have scales and rhizoids attached
organism_part_definitions.BRACT: modified leaf or scale, typically small
organism_part_definitions.**OTHER_PLANT_TISSUE**: (use this term if the plant organ, tissue or organism part you have sampled is not covered by the other plant organ and tissue terms above. Please describe the tissue or organism part in the OTHER_INFORMATION field [column BZ])
organism_part_definitions.MYCELIUM: mass of branching hyphae (fungal filaments), vegetative part
organism_part_definitions.MYCORRHIZA: fungal filaments surrounding plant roots or root cells, or growing inside them
organism_part_definitions.SPORE_BEARING_STRUCTURE: anatomical structure that produces new spores, reproductive structure
organism_part_definitions.HOLDFAST_FUNGI: central peg or anchor structure to attach to substrate
organism_part_definitions.STIPE: stem or stalk-like feature supporting the cap
organism_part_definitions.CAP: or pileus, top part of spore-bearing structure that carries fertiles tissue (hymenium)
organism_part_definitions.GILL_FUNGI: or lamellae, are plate-like or blade-like structures bearing the hymenium in the underside of the cap
organism_part_definitions.THALLUS_FUNGI: nonreproductive tissues, or vegetative body parts
organism_part_definitions.SPORE: unit of sexual or asexual reproduction, often single-celled
organism_part_definitions.**OTHER_FUNGAL_TISSUE**: (use this term if the fungal organ, tissue or organism part you have sampled is not covered by the other fungal organ and tissue terms above. Please describe the tissue or organism part in the OTHER_INFORMATION field [column BZ])
organism_part_definitions.NOT_COLLECTED: the information was not collected and is not available
organism_part_definitions.NOT_APPLICABLE: the data type is not applicable to this sample
organism_part_definitions.NOT_PROVIDED: the information was collected but is not provided at this time
organism_part_definitions.MULTICELLULAR_ORGANISMS_IN_CULTURE: multicellular eukaryotic organisms grown in culture
